newsitem.title: GERMANY: German state Bavaria March CPI down 0.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: German state Bavaria March CPI down 0.2 pct.

text.p: The German state of Bavaria said on Wednesday that consumer prices in March fell 0.2 percent from February and climbed 1.3 percent from the same month a year earlier.
Bavaria is the last of four states that make up the preliminary west German consumer price report to publish its March figures.
In February, Bavarian CPI climbed 0.3 percent from the previous month and was up 1.6 percent year-on-year.
The Federal Statistics Office is likely to publish the preliminary west German consumer price report later today. --Frankfurt Newsroom + 49 69 756525
